exposure: Inpatient post-cesarean analgesic regimen (oxycodone and acetaminophen combined vs. separated)
Combined Medication group (received combination oxycodone-acetaminophen only)
Separate Medication group (received oxycodone and acetaminophen separately)
outcome: Inpatient opioid use (intravenous morphine mg equivalents [MME] per 12-h period)
finding: An analgesic regimen with oxycodone and acetaminophen administered separately was associated with reduced inpatient opioid use in patients who underwent a cesarean delivery, regardless of gestational age, acuity levels, and mode of operative anesthesia.
